Genuine Cisco Console Cable 6 ft USB A to USB Mini-B – For Cisco 900 Routers & 3010 Switches

Upgrade your network management with the original Cisco Console Cable, designed to deliver reliable and fast connectivity between your PC and Cisco networking devices. Compatible with Cisco 900 Series Routers and 3010 Series Switches, this genuine cable ensures stable data transfer, easy configuration, and hassle-free troubleshooting. Built with premium materials, it guarantees long-lasting performance for IT professionals, data centers, and enterprise networking in Bangladesh.

Key Specifications:

  • Brand: Cisco (Original)
  • Cable Type: Console Cable
  • Length: 6 ft (1.8m)
  • Connector Type: USB Type-A (Male) to USB Mini-B (Male)
  • Compatibility: Cisco 900 Series Routers, 3010 Series Switches
  • Function: Device configuration, firmware updates, console management
  • Build Quality: Durable, high-quality insulation for long-term use
  • Color: Standard Cisco Blue
  • Use Case: IT support, network setup, troubleshooting, server room management
